markers.name: Fort Seminoe (rebuilt) and visitors' center
markers.coord_source: OSM node 7606427444 (historic=fort, the reconstruction); visitors' center 42.44187,-107.21947 from the Church location page map pin
markers.note: The 2001 NPS survey located the original fort in the hayfield near the visitors' center; no source says the 2002 rebuild sits on the excavated footprint.

markers.name: Sweetwater crossing and rescue sculptures
markers.coord_source: OSM way 120513102 (Sweetwater River), vertex nearest the cove (812 m south of the cove point); distances from Orton, BYU Studies 45:3
markers.note: Orton gives about two miles from the Devil's Gate camp and half a mile below the cove; the exact ford is not identified, and the Bowers sculptures have no mapped point.
